claim: @byokit/herdr 0.18.0 (from 0.17.2) is prepared for consumer installation: the packed tarball a consumer installs carries both merged API surfaces, exportConversation with an explicit accountFolder and the hostLaunch opt-in for Pi, and the example pin and lockfile entry move to 0.18.0 with it. steps: Run the release tool prepare for herdr=minor and read the version it wrote
Read the example pin and the lockfile entry for the same package
Pack the package the release publishes and read the tarball own package.json
Read the packed dist for both merged API surfaces, exportConversation with accountFolder and the hostLaunch opt-in
steps.result: The packed consumer artifact is @byokit/herdr 0.18.0 (from 0.17.2) with the example pin and lockfile entry moved with it, and both merged API surfaces present in the shipped dist.
